# Acer code.txt RSA public key (reference build)
#
# This is the PUBLIC modulus n embedded in A01UnlockPassword.efi, used to
# encrypt code.txt. Public exponent e = 65537 (0x10001). OAEP hash = SHA-512.
# A public key is public by design; it is published here so anyone can verify
# the scheme and attempt the re-encryption route (docs/02 §2.3) themselves.
# It does NOT let you decrypt code.txt -- that needs the private key only Acer holds.
#
# n (hex, 4096-bit):

e = 65537
